zh: 这个周末我们要把旧地毯掀掉。
en: We're {ripping up|pulling up|tearing up|taking up} the old carpet this weekend.

zh: 现在好的建筑工很难找。
en: Good builders are hard to {come by|find|get} these days.

zh: 这扇旧窗户漏进很多冷风。
en: This old window {lets in} a lot of cold air.

zh: 你的装修进展得怎么样了？
刷油漆之前我们把墙冲洗了一遍。
en: We {washed down|washed|cleaned} the walls before painting.

zh: 钻孔之前先把两块板对齐。
en: {Line up|Align} the two boards before you drill.

zh: 我够不着冰箱后面的插头。
en: I can't {get at|reach|get to} the plug behind the fridge.
{Tighten up|Tighten} the screws on the chair.

zh: 门把手在我手里掉下来了。
en: The door handle {came off|fell off|broke off|snapped off} in my hand.

zh: 我们得把走廊的油漆补一补。
en: We need to {touch up} the paint in the hallway.

zh: 我漏了一个步骤，所以柜子装歪了。
en: I {missed out|skipped|left out|missed} a step, so the cabinet's wonky.

zh: 他把旧电脑拆开，看看哪里坏了。
en: He {took apart|dismantled|pulled apart} the old computer to see what was wrong.

zh: 他把旧收音机拆开，想看看里面是什么样的。
en: He {pulled apart|took apart|dismantled} the old radio to see what was inside.

zh: 我花了三个小时才把宜家书架装好。
en: It took me three hours to {put together|assemble|build} the IKEA bookshelf.

zh: 我明天把电钻给你带过去。
en: I'll {bring round|bring over|drop off|drop round|bring} the drill tomorrow.

zh: 我一坐上去，椅子就散架了。
en: The chair just {came apart|fell apart|broke|collapsed} when I sat on it.

zh: 先把背面的贴纸撕掉再贴上去。
en: {Peel off|Remove|Pull off} the backing before you stick it on.
I need to {give back|return} his drill.
